summary: Re-enables three disabled tests in JdbcTest and RelMetadataTest, updating the expected plan and selectivity to the current optimizer output.

tests.evidence: Test-only change. Reviewer asked to keep one string literal per plan line, which was changed; mihaibudiu noted the plan is very hard to verify by eye. The new expected plan in testCloneGroupBy2Plan pins an EnumerableNestedLoopJoin(condition=[true]) cross product without anyone checking that it is acceptable.

doc_comments.evidence: Only @Disabled annotations and their comments removed.

change_description.evidence: The description calls the new plan more optimized, although it contains a cross-product NestedLoopJoin(condition=[true]). It also says the filter literal is folded to 1997:SMALLINT, while the filter still uses CAST($t4):INTEGER = 1997 and the SMALLINT appears only in the top projection.

performance.evidence: No production code, but the re-enabled plan test baselines a cross join, which a reviewer may want to flag as a planner regression.

correctness.evidence: Expected values were checked: 1.0 / DEPT_SIZE follows from the fixed four-row dept table, and testCloneGroupBy2 confirms the query results.

contradictions.evidence: The description's claims about the plan (more optimized, literal folded) disagree with the plan text the test asserts.

build_ci.evidence: No build changes; three more tests now run in CI.

plan.why: A small test-only change; one reviewer can check the pinned plan and the description's claims about it together.
